questions.stem: What is the correct order of steps in selective breeding?

options.text: Breed all organisms, then select the best offspring
Select parents with desired traits, breed them, select best offspring, repeat over generations
Clone the best organism and use only clones
Genetically modify the organisms first, then breed them

questions.explanation: Selective breeding involves selecting parents with desired traits, breeding them, choosing the best offspring from that generation, and repeating this process over many generations.
